own: As many changes as you want can be submitted as long as they're on the same screen, or if we can come up with a method where it will tally up the changes. If you have to switch between screens, you do your changes, hit okay, then go to another screen, do your changes, and then unless we can somehow get them all on the same screen. But if we cannot, then there could be a final way to submit them with a full tally or list of all the changes. Maybe even if we can design it, we could show what it looks like on the left before the change and what the consequence of the change is going to be, so they have a visual in front of them of what their changes are going to do. Obviously, if they're username and password only, they'll be advised that once they hit submit, a 24-hour hold will be put in place. But any serious account changes that put the account in jeopardy will happen immediately, deleting a team member or whatever. They won't actually be deleted right away; their access will be taken away, but once the 24-hour hold is up, then all the changes will actually be completed. Any serious ones will take place right away, or maybe even all of them should take place right away, but they don't become permanent until the 24 hours is up. And then also the encouragement to increase their security so they don't have to go through this again. And then, of course, the people that do have the security don't have to wait; the changes just go through, but they still get that visual representation of before and after so they can see what it's going to look like before and after their changes if we can build that into the system.
question: Does a later change restart the 24 h for everything waiting?
